scope: Exact 73-file allowlist in PUBLIC_MANIFEST.json and its referenced public_transport blobs only; read-only local release audit, no remote operation.

checks.detail: Independently reconstructed expected paths match all 73 manifest paths exactly. Only original manuscript/navigation, figure outputs and aggregates, plotting/build/export code, editorial and review records, and the reading package are staged.

Recomputed local SHA-256, staged SHA-256, size and Git blob SHA-1 for every record; filenames match Git blob hashes. No missing referenced blob. All non-Markdown bytes are identical to declared local sources. Six Markdown changes contain only link-target rewrites.

Independent content review, build inputs and state share the frozen local draft SHA. Final PDF review, state and package inventory share the staged PDF SHA. TeX and all eight figure-PDF hashes also agree. Public draft differs from reviewed local draft only in navigation links.

All relative Markdown destinations resolve against pinned base repository paths plus staged allowlist. No absent destination found. This verifies file/directory targets, not external server availability or anchor existence.

ZIP CRC and member traversal checks passed. Exactly 13 members, no unexpected payload; every member is byte-identical to its staged counterpart and matches PACKAGE_INVENTORY.json. Eight figure PDFs agree with BUILD_INPUTS.json.

Inspected allowlist/source roles, aggregate JSON structures, review chain and archive contents. No real/generated participant table, third-party original publication/codebook, unrelated data file or private review screenshot is included. Numeric figure bindings hold aggregate seed statistics and references, not participant records.

No detected credential/private-key pattern in staged bytes, PDF extracted text or ZIP members. JSON parses, PNG verification and SVG parsing passed; PDFs have no embedded files. The sole external SVG href is an ordinary draw.io help link, not a fetched image resource.
Four existing paths are navigation/current-focus documents; 69 destinations are new v15 artifacts. No deletion or existing frozen result replacement is present in the manifest.

notes: Eleven obsolete/unreferenced transport blobs remain locally. They are not in the reviewed manifest and are explicitly excluded; upload must use manifest records rather than a transport-directory glob.
The standalone ZIP rebuild receipt reported by root is local-only and was not used as a substitute for this exact-byte inventory audit.
limitations: PASS applies only to this exact manifest and referenced bytes. Any changed manifest/payload needs a renewed integrity check.
This audit does not certify the full historical repository, publication rights beyond the inspected original-artifact scope, or complete absence of every possible secret pattern.
Scientific content and visual layout remain bound to their separate frozen reviews; no experiment, participant-level analysis or visual re-review was run here.
This is not confirmation of remote synchronization, venue submission or an online Overleaf project. A separate remote byte-verification receipt is required.
